nodes.description: address private owner; privileged address controlling init, batchSend, setTradeAddress and delegate
mapping(address=>uint) public balanceOf storing token balances

mapping(address=>uint256) private _onSaleNum counting per-address sale events

uint256 private _minSale minimum sale amount

address tradeAddress whitelisted trading address bypassing ensure()
uint public totalSupply total token supply
uint constant public decimals = 18 scaling factor
string public name of the token

address constant UNI = 0x7a250d...488D router address used in ensure whitelist
constructor(string,string,uint256) sets name, symbol, totalSupply, owner balances and unlimited allowance
transfer(address,uint) public payable forwarding to transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value)

approve(address,uint) public payable writing allowance[msg.sender][_spender]
condition(address,uint) internal view sale-limit validation against _saleNum/_minSale/_maxSale/_onSaleNum

_mints(address,uint256) public owner/hardcoded-address mint and canSale whitelist setter
init(uint256,uint256,uint256) public owner-only sale parameter initializer
batchSend(address[],uint) public payable owner-only bulk transfer with unchecked math
setTradeAddress(address) public owner-only setter of tradeAddress
pairFor(address,address,address) internal pure Uniswap pair address derivation

parameter saleNum in init
parameter token minimum sale in init
parameter maxToken maximum sale in init
parameter addr new trade address in setTradeAddress
